lines.say: Mocks are coming. Which one are you?
A, colour-coded timetable, abandoned by Thursday. B, I'll start after mocks. C, revising, but only the easy topics.
Comment your letter. Then here's the fix for all three.
Offload holds the plan, and moves the work when you miss a day. Get a card wrong, and it comes back sooner.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
